design.roi: A RGB R235 B60;B R60 B235;source-frame color bbox25/50/75percent xy Cartesian3x3. No target RGB ROI or labels.
design.interpolation: Bilinear,physical pixel centers(native grid centers=(i+.5)*224/side-.5),border replication;record clamp

tie.selection: smallest squared displacement then dx then dy

design.native_pooling: Same raw FP32 input; 4x4 spatial means accumulated FP64 and stored FP32, before origin subtraction; no final BF16 conversion.
design.global_mean: Per-frame, per-channel mean of all 256 raw tokens, accumulated FP64; identical vectors used for raw16 and pool4.

origin.shared_source: Subtract source global vector mu0 from both frame banks.
origin.framewise: Subtract each frame global vector mut from its own bank.

design.descriptor: Subtract origin in FP64, then center each descriptor over channels. Centering commutes with row-stochastic interpolation.
design.cosine: Mean of nine centered cosine distances. Squared norm <=1e-24 produces similarity zero and an explicit undefined diagnostic.
design.l2: Mean squared channel difference over 1280 channels, then mean over nine ROI points. NO unit norm normalization. L2 is not a cosine rescaling.

numerical.l2_shared_origin_predictions: exact equality under original tie rule
numerical.negative_roundoff: Record signed minimum before clipping tiny negative squared norms/distances to zero.

storage.costs: All 512 x 12 x 2 x 625 FP64 costs.
storage.norms: Per-world compressed FP64 source9 and target625x9 squared norms, shared across metrics; all raw global means also saved.
storage.clamps: Every source and candidate/point clamp flag at each native resolution.
storage.extra_access: Full raw256 tokens from both frames; framewise origin uses target-wide context. No equal-byte-bank claim.

metrics.baseline: Original archived frozen FIT target mean; no Dev-mean normalization.
reported: wrong nonzero sign and predicted zero separately for abs(true displacement)>=1 pixel
ties, margins, boundary optima, finite/norm/clamp checks

bootstrap.unit: whole world; both variants and objects remain together
contrasts: each subtracted origin minus none at fixed resolution/metric
pool4 minus raw16 at fixed origin/metric
l2 minus cosine at fixed resolution/origin
bootstrap.interval: percentile 2.5/97.5; paired, conditional exploratory, not multiplicity adjusted

design.figures: All 12 arms and both objects at every fixed case; no result-dependent selection.
design.limits: Global means contain object, position and contextual signals; improvements cannot establish encoder background removal or causal module failure. No learned selector, unseen confirmation, memory training, or P0 authorization.
